svg.title: Contact and colophon
svg.desc: EMAIL: lawrence@reamus.app. DISCORD: btf_cookies. EIGHTBIT LABS: eightbitlabs.netlify.app. Sheets are generated by scripts/build.mjs from live GitHub data and refreshed daily. The constraint is no colour. With no hue to spend, volume becomes dot area, category becomes fill pattern, and the avatar is dithered to one bit so its rainbow reads as density. Archivo Black and IBM Plex, baked to outlines — web fonts do not load inside a README image.
